solo.name: transfer within balance succeeds
solo.trace:
solo check: transfer within balance succeeds
call: transfer(db, from_id=1, to_id=2, amount=30)
schedule choices: []
step 1   R1  BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED -> BEGIN
step 2   R1  WITH locked AS ( SELECT id, balance FROM accounts WHERE id IN (1, 2) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE ), debit AS ( UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance - 30 WHERE id = 1 AND (SELECT balance FROM locked WHERE id = 1) >= 30 RETURNING 1 ) UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance + 30 WHERE id = 2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM debit) RETURNING 1; -> UPDATE 1 [(1,)]
step 3   R1  COMMIT -> COMMIT
         R1  returned True
invariant ok: no balance below zero
invariant ok: expected state: SELECT array_agg(balance ORDER BY id) = '{70,40}' FROM accounts
